reviewer: pending_independent_review; not the C04 author or operator reviewer
scope: Existing run.json and operator-review.json only; no rerun, no raw evidence rewrite, no wider acceptance search.

conclusion.report_semantic_coverage: partial; node-c identity requirement remains conditional in the Agent report

supported: Run probes show separately signed node-b allowed before revoke (one actual upstream request), node-c denied before revoke (zero upstream requests), and node-b denied after revoke (zero upstream requests). The recorded node-c peer ID matches its controller identity binding.

Initial report correctly explains that node-b's effective grant already existed. The recorded exact approved confirmation and subsequent exact approved revocation, unchanged model-b, and configuration readbacks support those reported control actions.
Final report limits its revocation verification to observed local outgoing configuration and explicitly does not claim an Agent-executed live denial probe.

finding.severity: P2 report/semantic evidence gap; not a new production-code finding
finding.description: The initial report opens with completion and labels node-c locally verified, but the body says no displayed device is named node-c and makes the denial conditional on node-c being ungranted-peer. The checker nevertheless records passed, uncovered_requirements=[], uncertainties=[]. Identifying the requested subject is unresolved in the Agent-visible evidence, so complete goal coverage is not established.
finding.evidence: The controller's separately signed node-c probe occurs in before_revoke_probes after the initial report. It establishes the controller-observed denial, but cannot retroactively establish that the Agent identified or tested node-c when it reported completion.
finding.minimal_disposition: Keep the raw run unchanged; record the controller controls as observed and the Agent business/report outcome as incomplete. Do not upgrade business_success_seen to true using the runtime checker or later controller probe. No paid rerun requested.

confirmed_limits: This is an owner-role draft development run with disabled/not-formal-ready role overlay, one physical host, and independent_identity_proof=false. It cannot satisfy the formal two-physical-node requirement.
This review checks report semantics against the recorded trace, not an independent replay or fresh authentication of the supplied probe records.

minimum_validation.method: Read-only comparison of original reports, outcome fields, intervention order, signed-probe summaries and recorded identity mapping
